body.heading: Where in the world is Egypt?
paragraphs: Egypt is a country in Northern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Egypt is Cairo.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Egypt is Arabic.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Egypt is the Egyptian pound.

body.heading: How big is Egypt?
paragraphs: Egypt covers about 1,002,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Sudan.

body.heading: A fact to wow your friends
paragraphs: The pyramids at Giza were built in ancient Egypt as royal tombs. The Great Pyramid was built for Pharaoh Khufu around 4,500 years ago, and for most of that time it was the tallest building in the world.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The Great Pyramid was the tallest human-made structure for more than 3,800 years. Beside it stand two more pyramids and the Great Sphinx, guarding the desert edge of Cairo.
At Luxor, families can walk among towering temple columns at Karnak, then cross the Nile to the Valley of the Kings, where pharaohs were buried in painted tombs.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Egypt on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
